data.name: Glossolalia
data.detailed_description:
A fully voice-driven psychological horror game.

Your voice is not just how you play.
Your voice is how you survive.

Glossolalia is a psychological horror experience where nearly every interaction is controlled through speech. Speak to move. Speak to solve puzzles. Speak to survive.

Driving alone at night, you hear a strange radio broadcast.
A phone booth appears in the middle of the road.

You stop.

You answer the phone.

And something answers back.

In Glossolalia, you are pulled into a surreal, shifting world where your voice becomes your only tool — and your greatest vulnerability. Answer disturbing questions, navigate impossible spaces, and speak forbidden words to uncover the truth behind the entity trying to possess you.

But be careful.

Not everyone who speaks… comes back.

Features

🎙 Fully Voice-Driven Gameplay

  • Speak to move and interact with the world

  • Answer questions that change the story

  • Use spoken phrases to activate supernatural abilities

  • Your voice is your primary control

👁 Psychological Horror Experience

  • Disturbing questions and moral dilemmas

  • Unpredictable events and environments

  • Reality shifts around you as you progress

  • Minimal UI for maximum immersion

🕯 Speak Forbidden Words

  • Activate "Glossolalia" mode to reveal hidden elements

  • Speak phrases to manipulate the environment

  • Light candles, reveal ghosts, unlock paths

  • Discover new voice abilities as you progress

☎ Surreal, Atmospheric Worlds

  • Phone booths in empty darkness

  • Endless hallways and impossible architecture

  • Victorian mansions and abandoned spaces

  • Entities that react to your voice

🧠 A Story About Possession

  • Something is trying to use your voice

  • Most people don't survive the process

  • Few become something else

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Microphone required for full voice-driven gameplay
